actors.role: President and Presidential Secretary of Argentina, La Libertad Avanza
actors.blurb: Javier Milei and his sister Karina Milei have been driving news coverage due to their efforts to restructure Argentina's government and push through significant economic reforms. The recent resignation of Manuel Adorni and the appointment of Diego Santilli as Chief of Staff have been key developments. Additionally, their focus on electoral reform and negotiations with provincial governors to secure support for Milei's re-election bid in 2027 have been widely reported.
